mappings.sourceText: 光滑的弯曲表面也反射光线.
zh: 光滑的弯曲表面也能反射光，形成**像**。
en: A smooth curved surface can also reflect light and form an **image**.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 装饰新年枞树的玻璃球，在交叉路口上安装的凸面镜，望远镜里的球面镜——都是用以形成**像**的弯曲平面的例子.
zh: 装饰用的反光玻璃球、路口的凸面镜，以及某些望远镜中的球面镜，都是弯曲反射面的例子。
en: Examples include reflective glass ornaments, convex mirrors at road junctions, and spherical mirrors in some telescopes.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 这些**像**的大小已经不象在平面镜中那样，它们不等于相应的*物体*.
zh: 平面镜形成的像与物体等大，弯曲反射面形成的像则可能放大，也可能缩小。
en: A plane mirror forms an image the same size as the object, whereas a curved reflecting surface can form a larger or smaller image.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: **像**的位置也不同于平面镜成**像**的位置.
zh: 像的位置也不再遵循平面镜中物与像到镜面的距离相等的关系。
en: The image position also need not follow the plane-mirror rule of equal object and image distances from the mirror.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 在所有弯曲面的镜子中，我们只研究球面镜.
zh: 这一课只研究弯曲反射面中的一种：**球面镜**。
en: This lesson considers one kind of curved reflecting surface: the **spherical mirror**.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 把表面是球面的一部分和能象镜一样反射光的*物体*表面叫做**球面镜**.
zh: 反射面是球面的一部分的镜子，叫做**球面镜**。
en: A mirror whose reflecting surface is part of a sphere is called a **spherical mirror**.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 原球面的心叫做**镜子的光心**(图 141 上的点 $O$).
zh: 这个球面的球心在原书中叫作镜子的光心，也就是图 141 中的点 $O$。
en: The center of that sphere is called the mirror's optical center in the source; it is point $O$ in Figure 141.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

en: Figure 141
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 把球面的顶点叫做**镜的顶点**——点 $P$.
zh: 镜面中央的顶点叫做**镜的顶点**，图中的标记是 $P$。
en: The point at the middle of the mirror surface is the **vertex**, labeled $P$ in the figure.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 通过光心的任意直线叫做**镜子的光轴**——直线 $OP$、$OK$ 等等.
zh: 按照原书的用语，通过曲率中心的直线叫作镜子的**光轴**，例如 $OP$、$OK$。
en: In the source's terminology, a line through the center of curvature is an **optical axis** of the mirror, such as $OP$ or $OK$.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 在各光轴中，常常标出一条主要的光轴.
zh: 在这些光轴中，通过曲率中心和镜的顶点的直线 $OP$ 叫做**主光轴**。
en: Among these axes, the line $OP$ through the center of curvature and the vertex is called the **principal axis**.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 通过光心和镜子顶点的直线 $OP$，叫做主光轴.
zh: 在这些光轴中，通过曲率中心和镜的顶点的直线 $OP$ 叫做**主光轴**。
en: Among these axes, the line $OP$ through the center of curvature and the vertex is called the **principal axis**.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 主光轴和其它各光轴的区别仅仅在于，主光轴是镜子的对称轴.
zh: 它的特别之处是：对于这里讨论的对称球面镜，它也是镜子的对称轴。
en: What distinguishes it is that it is also the symmetry axis of the symmetric spherical mirror considered here.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 其余的光轴叫做**副轴**.
zh: 其余通过曲率中心的光轴叫做**副光轴**，原书也简称副轴。
en: The other optical axes through the center of curvature are called **secondary axes**.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 如果光线从球面的内表面反射，那么镜子叫做**凹面镜**.
zh: 如果反射面是球面的内侧，镜子叫做**凹面镜**。
en: If the reflecting surface is the inner side of the sphere, the mirror is a **concave mirror**.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 光线从外表面反射的镜子是**凸面镜**.
zh: 如果反射面是球面的外侧，镜子叫做**凸面镜**。
en: If the reflecting surface is the outer side, it is a **convex mirror**.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: **凹面镜**：球面镜的反射可以用观察平面镜反射的同样的仪器来观察.
zh: **凹面镜**的反射可以用观察平面镜反射的同一种光学圆盘仪器来研究。
en: Reflection from a **concave mirror** can be studied with the same optical-disk apparatus used to observe reflection from a plane mirror.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 为此，把凹面镜安装在圆盘的中心，把几条平行光线射向镜子.
zh: 把凹面镜固定在圆盘中心，让几条平行光线射向镜子。
en: Fix the concave mirror at the center of the disk and direct several parallel rays toward it.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 使中心光线在反射后变为反方向.
zh: 调整镜子，使中间的光线反射后沿原来的路线反向返回。
en: Adjust the mirror so that the middle ray returns in the opposite direction along its original path.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 反射以后两边的光线与中间的光线相交于一点（图142）.
zh: 在后面脚注所说的近似条件下，两侧的反射光线会与中间的反射光线近似会聚于同一点，图 142 与这个实验相关。
en: Under the approximation specified in the following footnote, the reflected side rays approximately meet the middle reflected ray at one point; Figure 142 is associated with this experiment.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

en: Figure 142
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 平行于主光轴入射到球面镜的光线在反射后相交于一点，这一点叫做镜子的**主焦点**(图 143)①.
zh: 对凹面镜来说，平行于主光轴的近轴光线反射后近似会聚于**主焦点**，参见图 143 和脚注①。
en: For a concave mirror, paraxial rays parallel to the principal axis approximately converge after reflection at the **principal focus**; see Figure 143 and footnote ①.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: ① 事实上，光线到光轴的距离与镜子的半径相比不大的时候，各光线相交于一点.
zh: ① 原书的条件是：光线到主光轴的距离，与镜面的球半径相比要很小，才把这些反射光线近似看作相交于一点。
en: ① The source requires the distance of the rays from the principal axis to be small compared with the radius of the mirror's sphere before treating the reflected rays as approximately meeting at one point.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

en: Figure 143
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 如果光线束平行于副光轴入射(图 144)，那么反射以后，光线会聚在另外的一点，此点与镜子的距离也等于主焦点与镜子的距离.
zh: 如果一束平行光沿副光轴方向射向凹面镜，在小角度、窄光束的近似下，它会聚的位置会偏离主焦点，图 144 与这种情形相关。
原书把这些点到镜子的距离看作与主焦点到镜子的距离相同，这个说法应放在同一近似模型中理解。
en: If a parallel beam approaches a concave mirror along a secondary axis, its approximate focus is displaced from the principal focus under the small-angle, narrow-beam approximation; Figure 144 is associated with this case.
The source treats the distances of these points from the mirror as equal to the distance of the principal focus, a statement to be understood within the same approximate model.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 所有类似点的总和组成一个确定的面.
zh: 不同方向的光束所对应的这类会聚位置合起来，形成一个焦面。
en: Taken together, the approximate focusing positions for beams arriving from different directions form a focal surface.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 当研究的副光轴和主光轴间的角度很小时，可以近似地认为这个面是垂直于主轴的平面，称为镜子的**焦平面**.
zh: 当所研究的副光轴与主光轴之间的角度很小时，可以把主焦点附近的焦面近似看作垂直于主光轴的平面，叫做**焦平面**。
en: When the angles between the secondary axes being considered and the principal axis are small, the focal surface near the principal focus can be approximated by a plane perpendicular to the principal axis, called the **focal plane**.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

en: Figure 144
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 现在我们把发光器两侧的光线集中使其会聚于主焦点.
zh: 再把发光器两侧的光线先引向凹面镜的主焦点，让它们在那里会聚。
en: Next, first direct the side rays from the light apparatus toward the concave mirror's principal focus so that they meet there.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 光线通过主焦点后，以发散光束入射到镜子.
zh: 光线通过主焦点以后向外发散，再射向镜面。
en: After passing through the principal focus, the rays spread out and then reach the mirror.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 光线发散的点就起着发光点的作用.
zh: 这个发散点便起着发光点的作用。
en: The point from which they spread out acts as a luminous point.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 不难证实，光线从镜子反射之后平行于主光轴射出，在这里我们又一次观察到光路的可逆性.
zh: 在同一近轴近似下，这些光线反射后成为平行于主光轴的光束，体现了**光路的可逆性**。
en: In the same paraxial approximation, reflection produces a beam parallel to the principal axis, illustrating the **reversibility of light paths**.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 现在我们把起着光源作用的光线的交点移得离镜子远一些，这时反射光线是会聚的，它们相交于一点，也就是产生了实像.
zh: 以上一次发光点在主焦点处的情形为起点，把它沿主光轴移到比主焦点离凹面镜更远的位置。
在近轴近似下，反射光线在镜子前方会聚，形成这个发光点的**实像**。
en: Start from the preceding case with the luminous point at the principal focus, and move it along the principal axis to a position farther from the concave mirror than the focus.
In the paraxial approximation, the reflected rays converge in front of the mirror and form a **real image** of the luminous point.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 反之，如果把光源移近镜子，反射光线就变为发散的，它们的延长线相交于一点，形成虚像①.
zh: 相反，把发光点从主焦点处移到主焦点与镜面之间，反射光线会发散。
把反射光线向镜后反向延长，延长线近似相交于一点，形成这个发光点的**虚像**①。
en: Conversely, move the luminous point from the focus to a position between the focus and the mirror, and the reflected rays diverge.
Their backward extensions approximately intersect at a point behind the mirror, forming a **virtual image** of the luminous point ①.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: ① 事实上，如果光线以与主光轴夹角很小的角度入射到镜子上，才可以认为反射线或者它们的延长线相交于一点.
zh: ① 原书还要求：入射光线与主光轴的夹角很小，才把反射光线或它们的反向延长线近似看作相交于一点。
en: ① The source also requires the incident rays to make small angles with the principal axis before treating the reflected rays or their backward extensions as approximately intersecting at one point.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: **凸面镜**：上面的实验也可用于凸面镜.
zh: **凸面镜**也可以用同一种圆盘实验来研究。
en: A **convex mirror** can be studied with the same disk experiment.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 把凸面镜固定在圆盘中心，让平行于主光轴的光线射向凸面镜.
zh: 把凸面镜固定在圆盘中心，让平行于主光轴的光线射向镜面。
en: Fix the convex mirror at the center of the disk and direct rays parallel to the principal axis toward it.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 反射线将是发散的 (图 145).
zh: 反射光线向外发散，图 145 与这个实验相关。
en: The reflected rays diverge; Figure 145 is associated with this experiment.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 它们的延长线在镜子后面相交于一确定的点，这个点叫做**凸面镜的主焦点**.
zh: 在近轴近似下，把这些反射光线向镜后反向延长，延长线近似相交于**凸面镜的主焦点**。
en: In the paraxial approximation, the backward extensions of these reflected rays approximately meet behind the mirror at the **principal focus of the convex mirror**.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 在这种情况下，相交于焦点的不是反射光线本身，而是它们的延长线.
zh: 相交的是延长线，不是实际传播的反射光线。
en: It is the extensions that intersect, not the actual reflected rays.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 这就是说凸面镜的主焦点是**虚焦点**(图 146).
zh: 所以凸面镜的主焦点是**虚焦点**，图 146 与这一结论相关。
en: The principal focus of a convex mirror is therefore a **virtual focus**, associated with Figure 146.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

en: Figure 145
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

en: Figure 146
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 主焦点到镜子的距离叫做**球面镜的焦距.
zh: 主焦点到镜子的距离叫做球面镜的**焦距**。
en: The distance from the principal focus to the mirror is the spherical mirror's **focal length**.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.

mappings.sourceText: 通常用字母 $F$表示**(与表示焦点的字母相同).
zh: 原书通常用 $F$ 表示焦距，并提醒读者：图中标记焦点的字母也相同。
en: The source usually denotes focal length by $F$ and notes that the same letter also labels the focal point in a diagram.
mappings.refsGranularity: Original assembled block; no invented per-sentence page split.
